raw_segments.text: Canterbury, she hath been then more feared than harmed, my liege, for here her but exampled
When all her chivalry hath been in France, and she a mourning widow of her nobles, she
hath herself not only well defended, but taken and impounded as astray the King of Scots,
whom she did send to France to fill King Edward's fame with prisoner kings, and make her chronicle
as rich with praise, as is the ooze and bottom of the sea with sunken wreck and sumless treasuries.
